_comment: Who wrote the words of the works and book parts added to the Layers cite list for the Wordplay thread's held passages (2026-11-07). Each record gives the words that name the writer, as printed or as the page shows them, and where they were read; all were read on 2026-11-07 by a first reader and checked again by a second.
The Gospel Coalition, Themelios, Ligonier, Theopolis, First Things and IVP pages are copyrighted: the records hold the byline only, and nothing of them is quoted anywhere.

matched.method: the Bible Hub comment on each cited verse, compared with the scan's OCR in runs of seven words

example.words: The war imagery here used St. Paul employs again

records.note: The contributors' leaf of newtestamentcomm03elli prints the book heading over this line in black letter, which its text layer garbles ('... to Ctmotljp anti CitttS.'). The heading reads as the Epistles to Timothy and Titus and stands between the Thessalonians entry (A. J. Mason) and the Philemon entry (Alfred Barry). The text layer also splits the name as 'S PENCE', so a search for Spence finds nothing. The contents leaf gives The First Epistle to Timothy from p. 178 and The Second Epistle to Timothy from p. 218. On 2026-11-07 the scan's search-inside failed with a server error, so each cited comment was compared with the scan's single-page text layer. Leaves here are the page index that reader takes. 1 Timothy 1:18 is on leaf 195 ('The war imagery here used St. Paul employs again'). The comment on 2 Timothy 3:2 is on leaf 244, under Unthankful ('who begin life with disobedience to their parents, with rare exceptions, are ungrateful'). The cited 2 Timothy 3:4 sentence is on leaf 244 ('vice which excludes all love for others'). The cited 3:2 sentence ('Selfishness well heads the dreary list') was not in the parts of leaves 243 and 244 that could be read. Titus, named on the same line, is not added: no cite needs it.
